name: CaseAntdForwardedRootAttrs
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "antd-forwarded-root-attrs" (anatomy). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: label > [input.sr-only + span.box] + span.text — the component forwards className/data-* to the HIDDEN input, not the visible label root (antd Checkbox/Radio)
